name: Earth’s Cold
body:
School transmutation [cold]; Level druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius emanation
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the earth to become arctic cold. Each round on your turn, including the turn the spell is cast, all creatures in contact with stone or earth within the area take 2d6 cold damage. A creature with the earth subtype instead takes 4d6 cold damage. A Fortitude save halves the damage taken in the round.

Additionally, the temperature in the area is dropped by 2 bands for the purposes of weather and temperature effects. If the area was already cold, the damage increases by 1 per dice rolled.

HD compared to your CL	Effect
9 HD or more under your CL	Unconscious for 10 minutes
6 to 8 HD under your CL	Dazed for 2d4 rounds, then confused for 1 round/level
1 to 5 HD under your CL	Dazed for 1 round, then confused for 1 round/level
Equal to your CL Confused for 1 round/level	Greater than your CL Confused for 1 round
